verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships iOS and Android SDKs, and a hands-on user reports the iOS SDK automatically posts reports on fatal errors. Events carry device context that can be correlated, and errors can be filtered by release. However, the evidence never directly documents Android or NDK native crash capture or the full device/OS/app-version payload attached to crashes. missing for 10: NDK crash capture evidence, explicit Android native crash capture docs, documented OS and app-version metadata on crash events, recent independent corroboration.
